just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on B3 and dwells most on B in Phrase 1. Phrase 2 (1:44.2) introduces Gb, centred on B. Phrase 5 (3:59.4) introduces Gs, centred on Gb. The line peaks at A4 (432.3 Hz) at 4:12.4. It closes on the tonic (Db4 → B3 → B3 → Bb3 → B3 → B3).
